param_input_item.param_description: a row vector characters or scalar string: name of graphics file.

description.p: imread reads the image data from the given file into a matrix.

Indexed images return an M-by-N uint8 matrix, a K-by-3 double colormap in [0, 1] and, when present, an M-by-N uint8 transparency matrix. RGB and RGBA images return an M-by-N-by-3 uint8 array; RGBA transparency is returned separately as the third output. Sixteen-bit grayscale PNG, TIFF and PGM images return an M-by-N uint16 matrix.

example_item.example_item_description: WebP transparency, indexed PNG and 16-bit grayscale data.
